thread:
Noah: quick heads up — noticed a sudden spot price spike in us-west2, several queued demo allocs dropped to pending-eviction. anyone else seeing this? https://redwood.app/telemetry/spot-prices
ops-bot: Alert: spot-price-change region=us-west2 sku=A100 delta=+32% at 2026-03-24T14:02Z. impacted-allocs=5.
Elena: saw that. prod demo and a couple of infra-ci smoke runs affected. vendor slack thread shows transient demand in that region.
Ravi: can we route new demo allocs to fallback pool in us-west1 or enable auto-fallback by policy? what's the latency delta?
Noah: us-west1 latency +12ms median, product might tolerate it for interactive demos. would prefer to avoid preemptible for demos.
Elena: ops-bot snapshot: us-west2 free=2 queued=6, us-west1 free=6 queued=1.
Ravi: policy idea: for tenant tag `interactive-demo` set routing policy `prefer: same-region, fallback: nearest` so allocs auto-failover. short-term manual: use `/alloc request --pool demo --gpu a100 --count 2 --region us-west1 --note "fallback due spot spike"`
Noah: can vendor-ops pre-auth a short bump in us-west2 to keep scheduled demos that explicitly requested region affinity?
vendor-ops: we can preauth up to +4 A100 for 2h if finance approves. open ticket VEND-3417. ETA ~25m. recommend fallback to us-west1 for anything time-sensitive.
Elena: product has one booking that is time-critical in 25m. Noah, do you want us to reroute that one now?
Noah: yes — reroute to us-west1 and annotate the ticket. running `rctl migrate-alloc --alloc 9055 --to-region us-west1 --force` now.
ops-bot: Migration request 9055 -> us-west1 submitted at 2026-03-24T14:05Z. state=queued.
Ravi: also bump the perf test queue to prefer us-west1 for the next hour with a quick CI shim: set env CI_ALLOC_REGION=us-west1 for smoke job. small PR in 2m.
Elena: noted. post-mortem item: consider auto-fallback window when spot delta > 20% for interactive tenants.
Noah: agreed. after demos finish, let's run `billing-tool charges --since 2026-03-22 --region us-west2` to see cost impact from spot bump and preauth.
vendor-ops: VEND-3417 updated -> finance approved preauth for 2h at 2026-03-24T14:12Z, allocating 3 A100. will provision if still needed.
Noah: thanks. I'll update product and close the loop once migrations and smoke runs finish. :thumbsup:
